summary: Ansible 15 cisco.mso deprecations (removed in v4.0.0): mso_backup, mso_backup_schedule, mso_label and mso_role on Nexus Dashboard 3.2+, mso_dhcp_option_policy(_option) and mso_dhcp_relay_policy(_provider) (use ndo_dhcp_option_policy and ndo_dhcp_relay_policy), mso_remote_location, and cloud selector and service graph modules not supported on NDO 5.x.
questions: Does mso_role work on Nexus Dashboard 3.2?
